item.tib: brnag pa las kyi drwa ba 'chi bdag gshin rje khros pa'i rgyud las srid pa g.yo 'khrug gis rlung lha yab yum las la bskul pa
item.coloph: rlung lha yab yum sras gsum sde brgyad kyi bskul pa/ stag la me 'bar gyi pho nya rno ngar spu gri 'dra ba lags so/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan du brgyud pa'o//
